title: Medication Blister Pack Completion Rate
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:medication dose_window=* dose_taken=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(dose_taken="yes",1,0))) as matched by dose_window
| eval a_taken_dose_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_taken_dose_pct
description: Measures the percentage of blister-pack reminders that end with a taken dose by dose window.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which dose window are helping or hurting blister-pack reminders.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a taken dose` on `care:medication` events and summarize the hit rate by `dose_window`.
visualization: Table of dose window with percentage of blister-pack reminders ending with a taken dose.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how often a taken dose happens for each dose window so you can see where blister-pack reminders go smoothly or get stuck.
